Actual local hardware

The proposed member receiver uses:

A 30 × 30 mm neck, with 20 mm free length.
A 50 × 50 × 25 mm head.
Certified quenched-and-tempered 42CrMo4 stock, specified yield floor 650 MPa.
6 mm root fillets.
A positive shear key and two M10 retention bolts at the replaceable root.

At a 12 kN normal screen, friction ratio 0.35 and 40 mm load arm, the nominal stress calculation is approximately 149 MPa; an introduced stress-concentration factor of two raises that to about 298 MPa. This is a preliminary strength check, not fatigue evidence.

The adjustment uses Tr20×1 screws, finite-length nuts and positive dogs. The intended load hold is mechanical. Electrical power is used to reposition and observe, not continuously to support the member.

A manufacturer load cell is useful evidence of availability, but not of assembled accuracy. For example, FUTEK’s LCM350 drawing specifies separate nonlinearity, hysteresis, repeatability, thermal effects and nominal deflection. Those errors must be combined with installation effects; they cannot be replaced with an exact local-force reading.
